notes: The microphone slider now sits with volume and brightness, where it belongs - a microphone level is a volume.
Those sliders are drawn as the progress bars above them: a 2px line in the same two colours, with a small handle. The grabbable area stays finger-sized even though the bar is thin.
Bluetooth and Wi-Fi have their own card, and the power plan has its own card with a link out to Windows’ own power settings page for everything this card deliberately does not do.

The four power buttons fit on one row again. They were two pixels too wide for the card; rather than shave a fixed amount off, the row no longer wraps and the buttons share whatever width there is - so it holds at any panel size.
One card, one switch: Panel Settings now has separate switches for Bluetooth & Wi-Fi and for the power plan.
